title: An adjunction whose left adjoint preserves finite products lifts to abelian group and commutative ring objects
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be categories with finite products [def-weil-category-product], with final objects $*$; for $f:Z\to X$, $g:Z\to Y$ write $\langle f,g\rangle:Z\to X\times Y$ for the morphism with projections $f,g$, $f\times g=\langle f\circ\mathrm{pr}_1,g\circ\mathrm{pr}_2\rangle$, $!_Z:Z\to*$, and $p_1,p_2,p_3$ for the three coordinate projections of $X^3=(X\times X)\times X$. An *abelian group object* of $\mathcal A$ is $(X,+,0,i)$ with morphisms $+:X\times X\to X$, $0:*\to X$, $i:X\to X$ satisfying (G1) $+\circ\langle+\circ\langle p_1,p_2\rangle,p_3\rangle=+\circ\langle p_1,+\circ\langle p_2,p_3\rangle\rangle$, (G2) $+\circ\langle\mathrm{pr}_2,\mathrm{pr}_1\rangle=+$, (G3) $+\circ\langle0\circ!_X,\mathrm{id}_X\rangle=\mathrm{id}_X$, (G4) $+\circ\langle\mathrm{id}_X,i\rangle=0\circ!_X$; a *commutative ring object* is a sextuple $(X,+,0,i,\cdot,1)$ with $(X,+,0,i)$ an abelian group object and $\cdot:X\times X\to X$, $1:*\to X$ satisfying (R1)-(R3), the axioms (G1)-(G3) with $+,0$ replaced by $\cdot,1$, and (R4) $\cdot\circ\langle p_1,+\circ\langle p_2,p_3\rangle\rangle=+\circ\langle\cdot\circ\langle p_1,p_2\rangle,\cdot\circ\langle p_1,p_3\rangle\rangle$. A morphism of such objects is a morphism $f:X\to X'$ of $\mathcal A$ commuting with the structure maps: $f\circ+=+'\circ(f\times f)$, $f\circ0=0'$, $f\circ i=i'\circ f$ (and $f\circ\cdot=\cdot'\circ(f\times f)$, $f\circ1=1'$). Let $L:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be left adjoint to $R:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$, with unit $\eta$ and counit $\varepsilon$, and assume $L$ preserves finite products: $L(*)$ is final and $\lambda_{X,Y}=\langle L\mathrm{pr}_1,L\mathrm{pr}_2\rangle:L(X\times Y)\to LX\times LY$ is an isomorphism; let $\lambda_*:L(*)\to*$ be the unique map. ($R$, a right adjoint, preserves all limits; $\rho_{Y,Y'}=\langle R\mathrm{pr}_1,R\mathrm{pr}_2\rangle$ and $\rho_*:R(*)\to*$ are isomorphisms.) For an abelian group object $(X,+,0,i)$ of $\mathcal A$ let $L(X)$ carry $L(+)\circ\lambda_{X,X}^{-1}$, $L(0)\circ\lambda_*^{-1}$, $L(i)$, and for a commutative ring object also $L(\cdot)\circ\lambda_{X,X}^{-1}$, $L(1)\circ\lambda_*^{-1}$; likewise $R$ with $\rho$. Then: (1) these are abelian group (resp. commutative ring) objects, and $L$, $R$ so extended, $f\mapsto Lf$, $g\mapsto Rg$ on morphisms, are functors $L^{\mathrm{gr}}$, $R^{\mathrm{gr}}$ between the categories of abelian group objects (resp. $L^{\mathrm{rg}}$, $R^{\mathrm{rg}}$ between those of commutative ring objects), commuting with the forgetful functors to $\mathcal A$, $\mathcal B$; (2) for an abelian group (ring) object $X$ of $\mathcal A$ and $Y$ of $\mathcal B$, a morphism $\alpha:LX\to Y$ commutes with the structure maps if and only if its adjoint $R(\alpha)\circ\eta_X:X\to RY$ does; hence $L^{\mathrm{gr}}\dashv R^{\mathrm{gr}}$ (resp. $L^{\mathrm{rg}}\dashv R^{\mathrm{rg}}$), with adjunction bijection the restriction of that of $L\dashv R$, and unit and counit those of $L\dashv R$ (the morphisms $\eta_X$, $\varepsilon_Y$ are morphisms of group, resp. ring, objects).

split_report.summary: Statement completed with the definitions it uses (abelian group and commutative ring objects as Stacks' quadruples and sextuples, axioms written as equations of morphisms built from pairings, morphisms as maps commuting with all structure maps, the comparison isomorphisms lambda and rho); content unchanged and as used by lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures step 4 (the only user; lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-module-adjunction cites only that node). Proof in six steps: the abelian-group clauses (1)-(2) from a new Mathlib leaf (Adjunction.mapCommGrp with Braided.ofChosenFiniteProducts; R preserves products by a second new leaf, Adjunction.rightAdjoint_preservesLimits) plus the two-line derivation of the iff; then for rings the comparison identities (naturality of lambda, the key identity m_L<Lu,Lv> = L(m<u,v>), the triple-product comparison theta), the transport of all axioms by induction on terms, morphisms and functoriality, the unit and counit respecting . and 1 (eta compatible with products, epsilon compatible with products, both checked on projections), and the iff with the restricted adjunction via the natural-bijection leaf. Mathlib has ring objects (Monoidal/Ring.lean) but no functoriality for them, re-checked with the three kinds of search. The source repository states nothing of this (grep mapCommGrp/RingObj/Grp_/mapGrp in WeilConjectures/: only imports of Cartesian/CommGrp_).
